noveltyJustification: Command placement and the read-only proof boundary are decided using the current route contracts and sk-code setup precedent.

label: The sk-code setup precedent is a read-only one-pass battery with per-leg PASS/FAIL/SKIP and repair commands; setup repairs remain explicit operator actions.
/doctor:git already owns git targets hooks and standards and the doctor route schema supports read-only targets, so setup fits as a third target in the existing route manifest.
A credible setup report resolves effective policy, worktree, Commit-Id, trust, hook, gate, and advisory inputs; it must label future builds and live runtime delivery as unproven by a read-only scan.
Reject setup auto-apply because the precedent forbids writes, trust authorizes repository code across branches, and existing mutation workflows require explicit approvals.
Reject a single healthy result based on exit zero or file presence because absent contracts mean no enforcement and the advisory deliberately fails open; show per-surface evidence and limits.
